authorization: Remaining implementation decisions delegated by user; no historical skill approval rules.

interface.response_rule: One stable ready/valid response per accepted command; capacity one active command per executor.
interface.bank_ports: Role-routed128-bit native reads with latency3 and byte-masked128-bit writes. Module computes memory word addresses internally; commands have no raw offsets.
interface.reset: Cancels active work and invalidates affected state; normal END/DONE is not reset.

numeric.architecture: Native BF16 x signed INT4 products for W4, native BF16 x BF16 products for QK/PV; shared8x8 unsigned significand DSP with W4 zero-extended3-bit magnitude. Exact FP32 product output into the unchanged FP32 adjacent tree16 and serial group accumulation. M1/N16/K16; one dot in flight. No W4-to-FP32 operand conversion. Six-stage elastic product core retains original leaf latency.
numeric.FP32_core: Custom six-stage FP32 RNE/FTZ add/multiply, unfused; exponent preparation and alignment are separate stages, with whole-pipeline response backpressure. Exact source/ROM simulation and OOC identities must match the implementation.

product_formats.W4: BF16 x signed INT4[-7,7], -8 reserved; full product delivered as FP32 without BF16 product rounding
product_formats.QK_PV: BF16 x BF16, full product delivered as FP32

numeric.output_word_schedule: Four native128 FP32 words per16 outputs; short QK N tails write only covered words. QK loads16 BF16 rows; PV reads two native128 words per key for16 outputs.

verification.golden: Fresh command_golden.safetensors and independent scalar arithmetic tests; exact numeric words plus descriptor changes.
verification.synthesis: Fresh200MHz OOC plus resource evidence for this exact module and later full integration.
verification.board: Not verified; user-run after full integration artifacts.
verification.native_product: Exhaustive65536 BF16 patterns x16 INT4 codes, plus131072 BF16xBF16 pairs; exact original scalar reference comparison, streaming ID/backpressure/reset flush.

operand_supply.cache_lifetime: Refilled every accepted W4 command/row; packed words replaced for every K32/output group. Reset cancels all return tags and requires full refill.
